newsitem.title: EUROPEAN UNION: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY.

text.p: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary - Opinion C-139/95 Balestra - social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 1 to 5 of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters and of articles 1, 2 and 5 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principal of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Special policy in favour of workers in companies declared "in crisis" that, in affording the possibility of early retirement and accrued benefit for fictive periods, apply a different retirement age according to a worker's sex, taking into account the fact that the general policy allows only female workers to retire at 55 without attaining the normal retirement age for both sexes of 60. - Opinion C-298/95 Commission v/ Germany - environment and consumers. Non respect. Failure to have transposed articles 3 and 5 of Council directive 78/659/EEC of July 18, 1978, on the quality of fresh waters needing protection or improvement in order to sustain fish life and of articles 3 and 5 of Council directive 79/923/EEC of October 30, 1979 on the quality required of shellfish waters. SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-313/95 commission v/ Italy: agriculture. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/66/EEC of July 14, 1992, setting down community measures for the control of Newcastle disease and of Council directive 92/119/EEC of December 17, 1992, setting down general community measures against certain animal diseases as well as specific measures relating to swine vesicular disease.
